page.topic: Digital (IoT) solutions for water and wastewater
target_prompts: What digital solutions help water and wastewater utilities cut energy use and improve operations?
fan_out: Which software, SCADA/telemetry and automation products make up the water solution?
How much energy (kWh or %) can treatment plants and networks save, and on what basis?
How does it integrate with existing SCADA/PLC systems and protocols?
Which utilities have deployed it and with what measured results?
How is OT cybersecurity and regulatory compliance handled?

criteria.rationale: Applications (treatment, desalination, networks) with context and brownfield modernization via EcoFit; no scope boundaries or fit guidance.
Several offers named with roles in teasers, but no prose on how components work together, no protocols, no technical parameter (c1+c4 fail -> <= 2).
Slogan H1 over a customer-story carousel; title has the noun phrase; no definition or direct answer in the first 100 words, no section answers or summary.
Promotional voice with unscoped leadership claims and hype; no limitations.
Seed answered loosely (up to 30% energy savings, solution areas) but fan-outs on integration, measured references and cyber are missing; sprawls into factories, AR and GRI reporting.
Named water utilities with one quantified result (Conroe 70%) and one-line context; no third-party validation; references are teasers only.
Segment problems named (leakage, energy intensity, GHG) near the top but no quantified or sourced problem fact (c3 fail -> <= 3).
Three quantified outcomes tied to EAE and Foxboro DCS, but 'up to' figures have no baseline, conditions or method (c3 fail -> <= 3).
No sourced statistics; only standard reference is the superseded GRI G4; no quotes or method-backed evidence; no owner.
Only states consultants support from strategy to implementation; no phases, deliverables or timeline.
Top block gives a scenario (scaling with demand) and a quantified EAE outcome, but no category definition or explicit audience.
Slogan H2s, frequent 'our solutions', and sub-segment solution content only in hidden tabs; lists and short paragraphs present.
Undated; cites superseded GRI G4 guidelines as current.
Solution-area overview fits Consideration for utilities; several descriptive CTAs and links to customer stories, though many vague 'Learn more' CTAs.

disclaimer: Citation-readiness of content only; actual AI citation also depends on retrieval, off-site consensus and technical access.
